note: Williams County park at Kota Ray Dam, about 10 miles south of Ray, rebuilt in 2024-25. Sites S1-S8 sit inside the loop road on the south peninsula, ringed by the swim beach and picnic shelters; S9-S12 line the west-shore road behind a strip of brush; N1, N2 and the group sites are in the north park. No-wake reservoir with a boat ramp at the south park, canoe/kayak launches and a fishing pier. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE: lakefront -> lakeview (not an --AWH value; the stored evidence was read on 2024 construction tiles). On the county's May 2026 site map, S1-S8 sit inside the south peninsula's loop road with the loop road, swim beach and picnic shelters between them and the water (~35-45 m), which the curation rules make a view; S9, S10 and S11 line the west-shore road ~12-20 m from the water but behind a continuous band of shrubs and small trees (brown brush on the spring map, dense green on Esri's summer image at ~48.2380,-103.1450); S12 is ~25 m back behind the same band; N1, N2, G1 and G2 are in the north park behind its parking lot, ~70 m+ from the water. No pad has an open apron to the shore. If the 2024-25 rebuild cleared the brush in front of S9-S11, those three could earn lakefront with a caveat - no current summer imagery or site photo shows it.
